query:
UPDATE services SET
  shortDesc = 'Sewer line broken? We repair and replace residential and commercial sewer lines in London Ontario using every technique available: excavation, UV CIPP lining, pipe bursting, spot patch, and ElastoFlake coating.',
  longDesc = 'Discount Drain offers every repair technique available for sanitary sewer lines. After more than 50 years in the business, we have seen every type of failure and we know which method works best for each situation. We will tell you honestly what your pipe needs, not just what is easiest for us to sell.

The five repair methods we use are: open-cut excavation, UV-cured CIPP lining, pipe bursting, spot patch (PipePatch), and ElastoFlake urethane spray coating. A camera inspection is always the first step. The footage shows us the exact location, type, and extent of the damage so we can recommend the right approach.

For new installations, we handle the complete process from design and permitting through to final inspection. We provide free estimates and a thorough site assessment to determine the most suitable layout and materials for your property. Our fleet includes pickup trucks, service vans, dump trailers, a roll-off dump truck, a skid steer, and mini excavators, giving us the equipment to handle any size of job.

We manage all required permits and coordinate directly with the City of London and surrounding municipalities. If your line runs to the property line, we can also explain the City of London Private Drain Connection (PDC) renewal program, which covers the section from your property line to the city main at a flat rate of $7,250 as of 2026, payable over 10 years through property taxes.

All repair work is backed by our standard warranty. We provide written quotes before any work begins.',
  benefits = '[{"title":"Every Repair Method Available","desc":"We use open-cut excavation, UV CIPP lining, pipe bursting, spot patch, and ElastoFlake coating. The camera inspection determines which method is right for your specific pipe."},{"title":"Full Fleet for Any Job","desc":"Our equipment includes mini excavators, a skid steer, dump trailers, and a roll-off truck. We handle residential spot repairs and large commercial installations with the same crew."},{"title":"Permits and City Coordination","desc":"We manage all required permits and liaise with the City of London and surrounding municipalities so you do not have to navigate that process on your own."},{"title":"Free Estimates and Site Assessment","desc":"Every job starts with a free site assessment and written estimate. No surprises on the invoice."}]',
  metaTitle = 'Sewer Repair and Installation London ON | All Methods | Discount Drain',
  metaDesc = 'Sewer line repair and installation in London Ontario. Excavation, UV CIPP lining, pipe bursting, spot patch, ElastoFlake coating. Free estimates. Call 519-451-8342.'
WHERE slug = 'sewer-repair-installation';
